prompt:
You are the requirements analyst of an AI agent factory. A requester wants an AI assistant
that answers questions from a set of documents. Read the BRIEF and the DOCUMENT OVERVIEW and
draft the requirements.

BRIEF:
I need an assistant that answers leave and travel policy questions for shore staff

DOCUMENT OVERVIEW:
- leave_policy.pdf (pdf, 2 page(s), 118 words)
  keywords: leave, days, annual, per, year, shore, staff, working
  starts: Leave Policy - Shore Staff 1. Annual leave. Shore staff are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues at 2 days per completed month of service. Up to 5 unused days may be carried forward to the next year; carried-forward days expire on
- spare_parts.csv (csv, 1 page(s), 9 words)
  keywords: part, description, unit, price, usd, supplier, fuel, injector
  starts: CSV columns: part_no,description,unit_price_usd,supplier; 2 rows
- travel_policy.md (md, 1 page(s), 96 words)
  keywords: travel, claims, business, approved, claim, inr, submitted, days
  starts: # Travel Policy - Shore Staff ## Business travel claims Employees travelling on approved company business may claim economy-class airfare, hotel accommodation up to INR 6,000 per night, and a daily meal allowance of INR 1,200. ## Submitting a claim Claims must be submitted in the HR portal within 30

Write:
- agent_name: 2-4 lowercase words joined by underscores, e.g. "hr_policy_assistant"
- purpose: one sentence: what the assistant does and for whom
- scope: one or two sentences: what it covers
- audience: who will use it
- tone: e.g. "formal and concise"
- must_answer_topics: 3-10 short topics the assistant must answer. Use topics the BRIEF asks for.
- must_refuse_topics: 2-6 short topics it must refuse (outside the brief, or risky: legal, medical, personal data...)

These are DESIGN requirements for the assistant, not answers to employees' questions.

Reply with JSON only.
raw_output:
{
  "agent_name": "leave_travel_assistant",
  "purpose": "Answer leave and travel policy questions for shore staff.",
  "scope": "Provides information on shore staff leave and travel policies, including annual leave, travel claims, and business travel policies.",
  "audience": "Shore staff",
  "tone": "Formal and concise",
  "must_answer_topics": [
    "Annual Leave",
    "Travel Claims",
    "Business Travel Policies"
  ],
  "must_refuse_topics": [
    "Legal",
    "Medical",
    "Personal Data"
  ]
}
